decisions.statement: Spotify gives back the fifty plays before the call and no more.
An hour holds fewer plays than that, so an hourly run loses none.
A run takes the plays past the newest play already filed.
A run that filed nothing new is a run that succeeded.
A run files the plays and then carries each play onto the track played.
A run that filed no play carries the tracks a sweep filed since the last run.

definition: the service carrying every play Alan finished into the pages that keep it
